highlights: Wednesday, August 12, 2026 first day; Thursday, May 27, 2027 last day
Separate planning days follow fall, winter and spring break

paragraphs: Alief ISD's 2026-2027 student year begins Wednesday, August 12, and ends Thursday, May 27. MP1 ends October 6, followed by Fall Break October 7-9 and a separate Student Holiday/Long Range Planning day on Monday, October 12. Students return Tuesday, October 13. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27.

Winter Break runs December 21-January 1. Monday, January 4 is a separate Student Holiday/Long Range Planning day, and MP3 begins Tuesday, January 5. Spring Break is March 8-12, followed by another planning day on March 15; students return March 16 for MP4.

The calendar also marks September 7, January 18, February 15, March 26 and May 3 as Student/Staff Holidays without giving them more specific names. The four marking periods contain 39, 44, 42 and 51 days, which add up to 176 student attendance days. This academic calendar does not show early-release dates or reserved weather make-up days.

statistics.label: Student no-school days
statistics.explanation: Counts weekdays without regular classes outside holidays and multi-day breaks, including staff or planning days. Overlapping entries count once.

statistics.label: Longest listed break

statistics.label: Long weekends
statistics.explanation: Counts three- or four-day no-school stretches formed by a weekend plus one or two confirmed weekday closures. Longer school breaks are excluded.

statistics.label: Full-week breaks
statistics.explanation: Counts continuous no-school stretches containing at least five confirmed weekdays without regular classes. Adjacent holidays and weekends remain part of the same break.
